part.text:
All 531 basics tests pass (9 skipped as expected). The fix is a one-line change in py/mpz.c:1828 — the comma is now only emitted when more digits remain (`!done`), preventing the spurious leading comma when the most-significant group is exactly 3 digits:

```c
if (!done && comma && (s - last_comma) == 3) {
```

Verified: `"{:,}".format(123_456_789_123_456_789_123_456_789)` now prints `123,456,789,123,456,789,123,456,789`, and negative/offset-group cases in `tests/basics/string_format_intbig.py` also pass.
